title: Restore real Apple Silicon temperature readings when ReMCP starts under launchd's minimal PATH.
changes: Build only the pinned, vetted macos-temperature-sensor@2.1.1 native addon with the active Node.js executable's directory prepended to the build subprocess's PATH.
Prevent node-gyp rebuild from failing with node: command not found under macOS launchd and fnm-managed Node installations; retain global npm --ignore-scripts protection for all other dependencies.

Preserve truthful unknown temperature when native sensors are unavailable; verify CPU, SoC and GPU measurements on Apple M1, restricted-PATH compilation and failure-mode regression tests without sudo.
Keep the generated public npm lockfile in npm's canonical package order so the reproducible release projection does not drift after npm install --package-lock-only.
